purpose: Qualify an exact non-iterative inverse theta->h for the SWAP 4.3.1 H_ENPR retention law used by C2B, including the rational wet-end continuation that legacy prhead does not invert.

forward_retention.A_AB: Use the exact source-derived SWAP term_105_a and term_105_ab construction from the H_ENPR forward branch.

candidate_inverse.saturated_endpoint: S=1 maps to h=0 for this bounded constitutive coordinate; positive saturated pressure is outside this inverse gate and belongs to a separate saturated-state/boundary representation.

legacy_prhead_diagnostic.known_source_structure: For default MvG with H_ENPR, prhead applies the normalized dry VG inverse whenever theta is not within 1e-6 of theta_s; it contains no inverse of watcon's rational h>=h105 branch.
legacy_prhead_diagnostic.question: Quantify how far legacy prhead deviates from the exact forward watcon inverse on the rational wet branch.

test_sets.head_roundtrip: dense deterministic heads plus exact joins and near-endpoints over [-10000,0] cm
test_sets.state_roundtrip: dense deterministic S values plus join-focused probes over the forward-retention image of [-10000,0] cm

legacy_diagnostic_outputs: legacy error at representative h=-4,-2,-1,-0.1 cm where in domain

exit_rule.pass: Persist the analytical inverse as the C2B state-to-head mapping and allow steady-face representation characterization to use S directly without root finding.
exit_rule.fail: Fail-close the mapping before any C2B Ross table characterization; do not introduce runtime root finding unless separately justified and contracted.

scope_guard: This gate qualifies only the unsaturated/zero-pressure H_ENPR retention inverse. It does not define positive saturated pressure head from theta_s, hysteresis inversion, elasticity, transient storage switching, groundwater coupling or FullRichards equivalence.
